summary: Verified 7.1/10 (reviewer 7.2, previous 6.5): NOT ON PAR, no sensitivity blocker. All three majors confirmed by direct inspection of the shipped PNGs and the fresh (2026-11-07) clip/lineup reports: the Lamplit deluxe splash blows out the face (frame max 252.9 at the face/hand) with a dark lantern (box max 220.6) and a pale hat underside instead of walnut; all six cards are posterized model renders on plates and the base hound is a painted cloth layer not cast by her flat hands; the head is a literal box with a flat side plane in every close view. Fixed claims hold: cast_a1/cast_ult hat steps 0.125/0.186 m, recall moves, base splash lantern is the frame max (251.8), skins separate, HP bar clears the brim. Minors kept: death sinks 0.21 m (671 verts) though the end pose reads as a kneel-fold; accent lens 2.49 % is inside the bible's 5 % budget but 16x the brief's own 0.15 %; Lamplit top band 66.4; attacks stop dead; stunned body nearly static (chest 0.001 m, hips 0). Score trimmed 0.1 because the cards (3 of 6 assets fail their job) and the box head weigh on every close view. Timing not measured (out of scope, load high).

findings.title: Lamplit (deluxe) splash hides and blows out the face; the lantern is unlit and the walnut lit-panel hat does not read
findings.what: Raised left forearm crosses the face; face renders as a white posterized smear and is the frame maximum. Lantern at left is a dark grey cage with a blue speck. Hat underside reads pale grey-beige, not walnut with glowing lampresin panels.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/tunlan/tunlan_lamplit_splash.png (Nov 4 20:47, current); _harness/_shots/closing_tunlan_lamplit_splash_face_x2.png; _harness/_reports/closing_tunlan_cards_measure.txt: frame luma max 252.9 at (1094,344) = face box max; lantern box max 220.6. Brief _design/fighters/tunlan.md cards section.
findings.gauge: A LoL premium splash shows a readable face/expression, one unmistakable key light tied to the skin theme, and its signature material at thumbnail size.
findings.fix: Re-stage at the cast_a3 f6 lamp-swing apex with the hand at the brim, camera under the brim so the walnut underside and lit panels fill the upper third; warm bounce inside the shade (accent core stays the only emitter); clamp figure highlights at least 30 luma under the lantern core with the existing _lantern_key.
findings.verifierNote: Viewed the shipped PNG: the face is unreadable and the brightest blob; lantern is clearly not the key. Severity right: deluxe card failing its job is major, not blocker.

findings.title: All six cards are posterized model renders composited on plates; the base hound shadow is not cast by the hands shown
findings.what: Splashes/portraits are game-model renders with a posterize/brush filter over a painted vista; stair-stepped edges, flat-lit finger segments, figure and plate do not share light. Base hound is a painted layer on the cloth; her hands are flat and parallel, so no cause-and-effect read. Noon Fair is a frontal arms-up stand on an empty plaza.
findings.gauge: A LoL splash is a painted illustration with integrated light, depth and an action moment showing the signature mechanic as cause and effect.
findings.fix: Pose hands in the cast_a1 hound gesture between lantern and cloth and project the hound along the lantern-to-hands ray; paint-over pass on the figure (lantern rim, occlusion into the plate, value match) instead of global posterize; Noon Fair holds puppet rods at a fair booth screen.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed visually on all three splashes and portraits. Roster-wide pattern, still a per-fighter major here.

findings.title: The carved mask is a literal cuboid head: flat side planes and square corners read as a placeholder block in every close view
findings.what: Head is a rectangular block with the face incised on the front plane; flat side plane and square jaw visible in portrait, Lamplit portrait, icon and splashes; no taper, no cheek planes turning, no wrap volume behind.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/tunlan/portrait.png (box side plane right of face); tunlan_lamplit_portrait.png; tunlan_noon_fair_splash.png; _harness/_shots/closing_tunlan_icon_usesize.png; _harness/_shots/closing_tunlan_death_row.png (hat off: bare brown box).
findings.gauge: LoL masked or wooden-faced champions are sculpted shells with tapered planes and a visible head/wrap volume even when stylized.
findings.fix: Taper the block to about 70 % jaw width, chamfer vertical edges, turn cheek planes 30-40 degrees into the sides, add a linen wrap behind the mask; re-render portrait/splash/icon.
findings.verifierNote: Tried to refute as a deliberate puppet stylization (her hands are blocky wooden segments too); the carving on the front supports that, but the untreated box sides and the bare box with the hat off read as unfinished at portrait size. Kept major.

findings.fix: Re-key death f30-45 to a side or seated-on-heels rest with hips about 0.25 m and robe above y -0.02; gate with art/tools/clip_floor.py.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced in the fresh report. Minor is right: the silhouette still reads as a fold-down.

findings.title: The hat's accent lens is still the dominant mark on the disc

findings.gauge: LoL identity accents are thin rims or small glints supporting the silhouette.
findings.fix: Slim arc of about 10 x 2 cm on the rim edge, or update brief §7 to the lens.
findings.verifierNote: Within the STYLE_BIBLE 5 % accent budget (harness accentOk true), so this is a brief-vs-build mismatch and a read issue, not a rule breach. Minor.
